description: This PHP class 'Step4' is part of an OpenCart installation process, responsible for rendering the 'step 4' view in the installation sequence. It loads language strings, sets page title, compiles data for the view, and loads other controllers for additional content sections.

classes.name: Step4
classes.description: Controller class for the fourth step of the OpenCart installation wizard, responsible for preparing and rendering the install step page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle the display of the installation step 4 page, loads language, sets title, prepares data and renders the view.
